verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, plus a published OpenAPI spec. A community comment confirms users can create API keys, though it complains those keys grant full account access. Nothing in the pack mentions a sandbox, test mode or any way to make registrations that don't cost real money, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: sandbox/test environment, non-billable test registrations, documented self-serve credential issuance flow, scoped test credentials.
